# Loop v1: close the loop — shop owner Keep or Pass, photographer's scratch-card coupon, redeem at the till

Written for Grok Build. Source of truth. Judge-lens and friction-lens apply to every screen: fewest possible taps, fun, big touch targets (44 px+), dark mode, en + th copy with parity green. Reuse: existing DB functions keep_post, pass_post, is_verified_owner, tables shop_owners (status pending|verified), coupons (holder_id, shop_id, post_id, day, code, status, used_at, expires_at), posts (status live|kept|passed, decided_at, decided_by), lib/supabase/*, lib/posts/source.ts, components/map/*, components/ui/*. Read supabase/migrations/0001 to 0005 first to see exact constraints, defaults and RLS (do not guess). Migration number: 0006, file only. May add ONE dependency: `qrcode` (or `qrcode-generator`) for QR rendering; no other.

## Known bug to fix in 0006 (caused by 0004 making shops.timezone nullable)
keep_post uses shops.timezone directly; when it is null the coupon day is null and the insert fails. Replace keep_post so v_tz := coalesce(nullif(timezone,''), 'UTC'), and validate with a safe fallback to 'UTC' if the zone name is invalid (use a begin/exception block around the at time zone call). Keep all other rules: verified owner only, post must be live and past expires_at, one coupon per person per shop per local day.

## 1. Migration 0006_loop.sql (file only; header: apply only after the captain writes apply)
- Fixed keep_post (above).
- Pass must delete the photo file for good. Storage objects cannot be removed by deleting rows reliably, so do it in two steps: (a) pass_post_begin(p_post_id) returns the photo_path WITHOUT nulling it after checking verified owner and ready state; (b) storage delete policy `post_photos_delete_owner` on storage.objects for authenticated: bucket post-photos and exists (select 1 from public.posts p where p.photo_path = name and public.is_verified_owner(p.shop_id)); (c) after the route removes the object with the owner's own session, pass_post_finish(p_post_id) sets status passed, decided_at, decided_by, photo_path null (only if the object no longer exists in storage.objects or the route confirms removal; simplest: finish checks not exists(select 1 from storage.objects where bucket_id='post-photos' and name = posts.photo_path)). Keep the old pass_post for compatibility but revoke execute from authenticated so the client cannot skip the deletion.
- redeem_coupon(p_code text) returns jsonb { ok, shop_id, holder_name, expires_at } : requires verified owner of the coupon's shop, status 'active' (read the status values in 0001), not expired, sets used and used_at, errors 'not_found','not_owner','already_used','expired'. Rate limit per caller: 60 redemptions per hour.
- claim_shop(p_shop_id): signed in; inserts shop_owners row status 'pending' (once), returns the status. No automatic verification (the captain or Gatekeeper verifies; for demos the captain verifies his own account by hand).
- Tests: text assertions on the SQL like lib/db/migration.test.ts.

## 2. Owner side (/owner)
- Entry points: on a shop's map sheet a small "I own this shop" link (calls claim_shop; then shows "Waiting for verification"); header link "My shops" visible only when the user has any shop_owners row.
- /owner: if no verified shop show the pending state in plain words. If verified: an inbox of moments whose 2 hours are over and are undecided, newest first, one big card at a time: the blurred photo, caption/facts, photographer first name, and two huge buttons "Keep" (accent) and "Pass". Swipe right = Keep, swipe left = Pass, both also buttons; haptic via navigator.vibrate when available. Keep shows confetti-free quick check animation and "Coupon sent to <name>". Pass says plainly "Photo deleted for good." and is not undoable (confirm by requiring a swipe past 40 percent or a second tap within 3 s on the button "Tap again to delete for good").
- Empty state: "All caught up" with the day's counts. API routes under app/api/owner/* for keep, pass (runs begin, removes object with the user session, then finish), redeem. Return plain error codes; tests with mocked clients for each route (unauthorized 401, not_owner 403, ok 200, storage failure leaves the post undecided).
- Kept photos appear on the shop page (/shop/<slug>, create a simple page if missing: name, kept photos with "Photo by <first name>", live pin if any). Add a "Share" button on each kept photo: navigator.share({ files, text }) with the photo and a caption built from facts + credit (fall back to download + copy caption). Caption helper pure + tested (en/th).

## 3. Photographer side (/wallet)
- /wallet: list of coupons (active first). An active coupon is a scratch card: tap or drag to scratch (canvas) then the shop name, offer line ("Show this at the till"), expiry and a QR code of the coupon code appear, plus the short code in large type for typing. Used and expired coupons are dimmed. Realtime: subscribe to coupons for the holder so a new coupon appears with a small animation while the page is open; also a header badge with the number of active coupons on /map.
- Shop owner redeem: /owner/redeem with a text field for the code and a camera QR scanner only if cheap (BarcodeDetector API when available, else manual entry); success shows a big green "Valid" with the holder's first name, and marks it used.

## 4. Tests, docs, report
- Existing 114+ tests stay green; build passes. README section "The loop": who sees what, that Pass deletes the file for good, coupons one per person per shop per day, and what verification means for now. Branch feat/loop-v1 from main, commit by explicit path after each section, NO push. Report: commits, test count, files, open questions, and "0006 is only a file until the captain writes apply."

## 5. Added by captain (10:45 PM): decision window and anonymous place facts (put into migration 0006 and the owner routes)
- Decision window: an undecided moment stays in the owner's inbox for 7 days after its 2 hours end (decide-by = expires_at + 7 days; show "N days left"). After that the inbox hides it, and it counts as passed for display. Automatic deletion of the file needs a server cleanup job with an admin key that does not exist yet; do NOT add a service-role key. Leave a documented TODO in the README and an `expired_undecided` helper that lists them.
- New table public.place_facts (in 0006): id uuid pk default gen_random_uuid(), shop_id uuid not null references shops on delete cascade, observed_at timestamptz not null default now(), facts jsonb not null (object, max 4096 bytes), post_id uuid null references posts(id) on delete set null (temporary link used only while the post exists), created_at. RLS: select for anon and authenticated (public place knowledge); no insert, update or delete policies for clients (server functions only). Index (shop_id, observed_at desc).
- Facts never contain captions or free text from the person: store only items [{name, price, currency}], crowd, open_status, signals, sign_language. Strip `caption` and `captions` when copying from posts.facts.
- Fill: create_post (security definer) inserts a place_facts row with post_id when p_facts is not null. keep_post: unchanged apart from the tz fix; the row stays linked while the photo is kept. pass_post_finish: set the post's text_original, text_translated and facts to null, and set place_facts.post_id to null so the record is anonymous. delete_own_post: delete the linked place_facts row too (the person's own deletion removes their facts).
- GET /api/places/export and stats stay as they are. Add GET /api/places/[shopId]/facts (public, cached 60 s) returning the latest 20 anonymous facts for a shop, used later for "typical prices" and busy times on the shop page. Add a tiny "Usually: <items with typical price>" line on /shop/<slug> from the last 20 facts when at least 3 exist (pure helper, tested).
- Posting line (en + th) updates to: "The photo is deleted if the shop passes. We keep anonymous facts about the place, like prices and busy times."
- Tests: migration text assertions for the new table, RLS and function changes; helper tests; route tests; README section "What we keep".
